description: This file provides functions for computing CSP hashes for inline scripts in HTML, and generating a Content Security Policy (CSP) header string with customizable script hash hashes.

methods.name: computeInlineScriptHashes
methods.description: Computes SHA-256 CSP hashes for inline <script> blocks in an HTML string, excluding scripts with a `src` attribute.

methods.name: buildControlUiCspHeader
methods.description: Builds a Content Security Policy header string, optionally including hashes of inline scripts.
